metadata.description: General-purpose Claude Code skills — versioned, validated, installable. Domain-agnostic authoring aids that aren't tied to any one plugin's job, distributed as cohesive skill-bundle plugins.

plugins.name: design-skills
plugins.description: Design-domain skills: layout-decomposer (read/grade/design a UI on OUTSIDE-IN x INSIDE-OUT axes + a four-archetype ASCII-wireframe library), mermaid-decomposer (create/grade advanced Mermaid diagrams on INTENT x RENDER axes + a gated M1-M6 rubric + a mechanized render-check), component-decomposer (decompose/design/grade zero-dependency web components on COMPOSE x REALIZE axes + a deterministic geometry engine — the (height-glyph)/2 law + XS–2XL ramp — a contract linter, and controls/overlays recipes), color-science (perceptual color — spaces, gamut, contrast/APCA, harmony, CVD — with a TypeScript color library + 54 interactive demos), and typography-lettering (type anatomy, classification, metrics, scripts, and the modern CSS text surface).

plugins.name: code-skills
plugins.description: Engineering-domain skills: code-decomposer (grade a unit of code on SPEC x EXECUTION — right + provably runs — with an execution harness and a test-vacuity linter that attacks the 'green but wrong' quadrant), regex-decomposer (LANGUAGE x MATCH — a pattern that means the right language and won't ReDoS, with an example-set + ReDoS checker), query-decomposer (SEMANTICS x EXECUTION — a SQL query at the right grain that actually plans, with a SQL linter + EXPLAIN harness), and figma-plugins (build/review/test Figma plugins across the sandbox<->iframe message bridge).

plugins.name: data-skills
plugins.description: Data-domain skills: extraction-decomposer (decompose/design/grade a structured extraction on FIDELITY x VALIDITY axes — is the JSON both schema-valid and true to the source — scored separately, with a deterministic groundedness check that catches the invented values a schema gate can't see; the instructive inversion — gate validity, adversarially verify fidelity).

plugins.name: meta-skills
plugins.description: Meta-domain skills (skills about skills): routing-decomposer (decompose/design/grade a skill's frontmatter description on INSTRUCTION x ROUTING axes — does it say the right thing AND fire on the right cases, not over- or under-trigger — scored separately, with a mechanized precision/recall/F1 routing-eval over a labeled corpus plus a description linter).

plugins.name: reasoning-skills
plugins.description: Reasoning-domain skills: proof-decomposer (decompose/design/grade a deductive argument or math proof on ARGUMENT x VERIFICATION axes — are the steps valid AND do they prove the stated claim, not a subtly different one — scored separately, with a proof-structure checker that catches circular reasoning, dangling citations, and unreachable goals, plus a numeric counterexample search).

plugins.name: ops-skills
plugins.description: Operations-domain skills: config-decomposer (decompose/design/grade a config or infrastructure-as-code artifact on INTENT x VALIDITY axes — does it declare the right desired-state AND validate/plan cleanly, not provision the wrong thing — scored separately, with a validate/plan harness, a safety linter for plaintext secrets, :latest, and wide-open permissions, and the plan-is-the-contract doctrine).
